directions: DIRECTIONS: In Part A you will hear short conversations between two speakers. At the end of each conversation, a third speaker will ask a question about what the first two speakers said. After you hear a conversation and the question, read the four choices and select the one that is the best answer to the question the speaker asked. Then, on your answer. sheet, find the number of the question and blacken the space that corresponds to the letter for the answer you have chosen. Blacken the space completely so that the letter inside the space does not show.
